name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 17 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-11-15, at wavelengths from 0.90 to 4.24 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
